by: owner 2026-10-22: 'we need more study and more data and more tips to turn off league'
rule: The learned tiers may RE-RANK tips inside a league but may NEVER switch a league off. Where the learned model assigns AVOID to a candidate in a league that has not passed the league-off test, that candidate keeps v9's production tier (scheme LEARNED_LEAGUE_PROTECTED). The swap rule of v1 is evaluated on LEARNED_LEAGUE_PROTECTED, not on raw LEARNED.

league_off_test.unit: league x market x model_type, settled first-sight tips
league_off_test.why_600: ~ the tips needed to detect a -10% league at 95% one-sided / 80% power (619), or a -15% league with Bonferroni across ~20 cells (592); assumptions: flat 1u, odds ~2.0, per-bet sd ~1.0; cross-checked by simulation
league_off_test.criteria: ALL of: n >= 600; ROI upper bound of a Bonferroni-corrected (20 cells) 95% one-sided CI < 0; mean CLV <= 0 where >= 50% close coverage; learned model also assigns AVOID to >= 90% of that league's candidates; holds in BOTH halves of the record
league_off_test.result: a league passing it is PROPOSED to the owner to stop tips (collection always continues); never automatic
